policies.assertion: Every component contract declares its accessibility block: role, how its accessible name is produced, which state changes are announced, keyboard operation, focus behaviour and what is hidden from the reader. AA contrast pairs alone are not enough.
Native slots carry variable content; variants carry size, hierarchy and state. A slot never replaces a variant, and every slot declares default content and preferred instances.

No action runs above the project ceiling declared in governance/autonomy.json. The effective permission of a capability is the lower of its natural level and the ceiling; raising the ceiling goes through a proposal.
Every non-trivial change to the design system starts as a proposal in proposals/, with evidence, impact, migration and an approver, before anything is written in Figma or in code.
Nothing is removed without an entry in schemas/governance/lifecycle.json declaring since, removeIn, reason and replacement.
A deprecated item is not removed before policy.minNoticeDays have passed since its 'since' date.
After policy.blockNewUsageFromDay, code must not introduce new usage of a deprecated item; existing usage only warns until then.
The design-system version in agent-manifest.json follows semver against the previous release baseline: removals and renames are major, additions minor, value-only changes patch.
Primitive color tokens are never consumed directly.
Patterns do not create component-specific variables.
Existing names, collections, modes, aliases, keys and component structure are preserved.
Every variable uses the narrowest scope compatible with its actual use.
Every variable has a concise usage description.
No unnamed or generic node names.
Structural containers use Auto Layout.
Every bindable visual or structural property uses a variable or style.
Designer-approved Desktop and Mobile typography exists first.
Every COMPONENT_SET or standalone COMPONENT in the component sources has a schemas/components/<slug>.schema.json, generated in the same sync.
api.properties mirrors componentPropertyDefinitions one-to-one, with kind, default and (for INSTANCE_SWAP) the resolved default component.
Every INSTANCE inside the default variant, visible or hidden, appears in api.nestedInstances and its slug in relations.uses.
If the component has an INSTANCE_SWAP property or a nested icon instance, api.icons.hasIcon is true and lists swap properties and default icons.
Every icon instance inside a component is exposed through an INSTANCE_SWAP property with a real icon as default.
scripts/token-audit.py reports zero errors on components.css, UI/ and the showcase before any commit and in CI.
icon/size, layer, motion and elevation exist in Figma (or are declared not applicable in tokens.md) and are mirrored in tokens.css.
Icon width/height only use --icon-size-* tokens, in Figma and in CSS.
Every layout decision in a screen (section rhythm, container width, grid, panel behavior, layer) is covered by a rule in patterns.md § Composición de pantalla.
Every contract file in docs/components/ and docs/patterns/ and every schema carries a code example whose classes exist in components.css.
